title: Religion & Society: Foundations
welcome_lead: Today you'll meet the vocabulary for religion, prejudice, pluralism and life in multicultural Britain.
meta_desc: GCSE RS Religion & Society foundations — pluralism, secularism, prejudice and discrimination.
final_note: You now know the foundational terms for religion in society.

concepts.def: Sacrament of unity between man and woman until death (Catholic); some Anglicans bless same-sex unions; vows include faithfulness.
Contract requiring offer, acceptance, witnesses, mahr (dowry); permits up to four wives with equal treatment; polygamy rare today.
Christianity: discouraged but accepted (Anglican remarriage allowed); Islam: triple talaq (Sunni); Catholicism only annulment.
Catholic ban on artificial methods (Humanae Vitae 1968); Protestants generally accept; Islam permits with mutual consent.
Diverse views: progressive Christians/Jews celebrate; Catholic, Orthodox, most Muslim/Hindu/Sikh traditions oppose; debate over Bible passages.
Religions emphasise parental love and child obligations; Honour Father and Mother (Exodus 20); Confucian filial piety.

walkthroughs.body_html:
The UK is religiously diverse. The 2021 Census recorded around 46% Christian and 6% Muslim, with about 37% saying 'no religion'.

Multicultural means many cultures live together; multi-faith means many religions coexist.

Religious freedom is protected by the Human Rights Act 1998 and Equality Act 2010.

Prejudice is what you think — judging someone before knowing them.

Discrimination is what you do — treating people unfairly based on prejudice.

Forms include racism, sexism, ageism, religious discrimination and homophobia. UK law forbids discrimination on nine 'protected characteristics' (Equality Act 2010).

Christianity: 'There is neither Jew nor Gentile, neither slave nor free, nor is there male and female, for you are all one in Christ Jesus' (Galatians 3:28).

Islam: 'O mankind! We created you from a single soul. and made you into nations and tribes that you may know one another' (Qur'an 49:13).
